vackyPlanArtifact.title: Completed Past Trips Memories Module V1

summary.paragraph: Build memory-first as an accepted Vacky product direction, using the existing Trip and Location itinerary model instead of a parallel itinerary system. V1 adds explicit completed-trip memory mode, structured memory signals, deterministic graph-like JSON snapshots, and a read-only traveler profile preview. It does not ship AI inference, embeddings, photos, or a runtime graphify dependency yet.

chosenDefaults.default: Accept memory-first and record a brain decision.
Add a planned/completed mode toggle to existing trip creation.
Use relational source rows plus generated snapshot JSON.
Prepare for later, do not call an AI provider in v1.

keyChanges.change: Add tripMode to Trip with values PLANNED and COMPLETED; profile generation uses only explicit COMPLETED trips.
Add trip-level memory fields: memorySummary, overallAppreciation 1-5, travelStyleTagsJson, pace, companions, hospitalityNotes, and wouldRepeatTrip.

Add location-level memory fields: memoryVerdict with FAVORITE, LIKED, NEUTRAL, and SKIP_NEXT_TIME; wouldReturn; and memoryTagsJson, while preserving existing appreciation, priceSentiment, notes, placeCategory, and placeTypes.
Add SpacetimeDB snapshot tables: trip_memory_snapshot and traveler_profile_snapshot, storing summaryJson, profileJson, graphJson, sourceTripCount, sourceUpdatedAt, and timestamps.
Add reducers for create_trip with tripMode, save_trip_memory, and deterministic snapshot regeneration. Recompute snapshots after completed-trip memory saves and completed-trip itinerary create/save.
Extend safe read procedures/helpers to return trip memory fields, latest trip memory snapshot, and latest traveler profile snapshot.
Add /memories as the profile/home surface: completed trips, top categories, style tags, pace/companions patterns, favorite/skip signals, and graph snapshot stats.
Add a Memories tab on trip detail for completed-trip reflection and location memory signals. Planned trips show a prompt to convert/save as completed memory.
Update /trips/new with a Planning a future trip vs Remembering a completed trip toggle; dates remain required and the existing itinerary flow remains reusable for both.

interfacesAndDataRules.rule: Snapshot graphJson should use deterministic nodes and edges, for example traveler, trip, location, category, tag, pace, companions, plus edges like VISITED, LIKED, WOULD_RETURN, HAS_STYLE, and PREFERRED_PACE.
Profile generation is deterministic only: counts, averages, top categories/tags, favorite locations, skip signals, preferred price sentiment, pace distribution, and simple generated summary text.
Server actions must call requireSession() and reducers must enforce trip ownership with the existing ownership guard pattern.
Do not expose profile or snapshot data across users; all reads must be scoped by current session user.
Do not add OpenAI/API keys, vector DB, background queue, UploadThing photo flows, or graphify runtime integration in v1.

ownership.owner: Own SpacetimeDB schema, reducers, procedures, generated bindings, server actions, and app-side mappers.
Own /trips/new, trip detail Memories tab, /memories, profile preview UI, form pending states, and responsive/a11y behavior.
Perform final pass because this touches SpacetimeDB schema/reducers, auth ownership, server/client boundaries, and multiple feature areas.

workflow.step: Update app imports from generated bindings.

brainWorkflow.step: Update product direction, current surface, data architecture, risks, now, and log.
Refresh graphify after meaningful brain and code changes.

suggestedBrainCommands.command: Run $vacky-brain plan with prompt: "Plan accepted memory-first completed past trips memories module: tripMode, structured memory signals, deterministic snapshot JSON, read-only traveler profile preview, no AI/photos in v1."

Run $vacky-brain sync with prompt: "Completed past trips memories module implemented. Sync product direction, current surface, data/auth architecture, risks, now, and log; confirm graphify refresh need."
Run $vacky-brain graph with prompt: "Refresh graphify after completed-trip memories module and memory-first decision updates."

testPlan.manualCheck: Create a planned trip and confirm it does not affect traveler profile.
Create a completed trip and confirm it appears in /memories.
Add/edit itinerary stops for a completed trip and confirm snapshots/profile update.
Save trip/location memory fields and confirm profile preview changes.
Confirm unauthorized users cannot read or mutate another user's memory/profile data.
Confirm existing itinerary create/edit/reorder still works for planned trips.
Confirm mobile layout for /trips/new, trip Memories tab, and /memories.

assumptions.assumption: Existing trips without explicit tripMode default to PLANNED for profile inclusion, even if their dates are in the past.
The existing date-derived trip stamp can remain as temporal UI, but memory/profile inclusion depends on explicit tripMode == COMPLETED.
AI traveler-profile inference remains a later stage that can consume traveler_profile_snapshot.profileJson and graphJson.
Deployment remains local-only SpacetimeDB for this branch.
